notes.note: Reviewed the macOS libproc counter read and the exact-birth join at the endpoints of the idle CPU window. Interrupt wakeups and package-idle wakeups are separate counts. Endpoint-only processes are excluded and reported, and an untrusted shared process makes the value not measured. The 65 focused tests include an isolated macOS source run with real measured counters. A removed birth check failed the gap assertion and passed again after restoration. The report remains outside the budget and does not establish energy use or packaged Track A.
